item.description:
Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis (@Dev_Fadnavis) posts on 'X', "Our leader, Hon. Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amitbhai Shah met with them today in New Delhi and held detailed discussions on the drought situation in Maharashtra. They were apprised of the full situation in the state, and information was provided about the measures being taken by the state government. A memorandum was also submitted on behalf of the state government in this regard. Drought has been declared in 265 talukas of Maharashtra, and various drought relief schemes have been implemented. In such a situation, a request was made to them to provide maximum assistance to Maharashtra through NDRF. Hon. Amitbhai Shah assured that maximum assistance would be provided to Maharashtra. He also informed that a central government team will visit Maharashtra between October 8 and 11 to assess the situation. I am extremely grateful to him for assuring that the central government will stand firmly with Maharashtra."

item.title: LG Ladakh (@lg_ladakh) posts on 'X', "Proud to introduce India’s first high-altitude wildlife safari in Ladakh! Just two months after our August 5 an...
item.description:
LG Ladakh (@lg_ladakh) posts on 'X', "Proud to introduce India’s first high-altitude wildlife safari in Ladakh! Just two months after our August 5 announcement, today flagged off 6 specially designed open-back vehicles for the Ladakh Snow Leopard Safari, during the Wildlife Week 2026 celebrations at Leh. These safaris will initially operate in Rumbak, Shang, and Uley, offering visitors a rare, guided opportunity to witness the elusive snow leopards, Himalayan brown bears, wolves and over 340 bird species and around 1,800 vascular plant species. Led by trained local drivers and wildlife guides, additional routes are being identified across Hemis National Park, Changthang, Karakoram Wildlife Sanctuary, Nubra, Zanskar, Sham, Kargil, and Drass. Also inaugurated the first of its kind AI-based Human-Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Device, developed to strengthen human-wild coexistence in Ladakh. This initiative seeks to create a unique model of environment conservation and eco-tourism, through community participation. Apart from curbing incidents of illegal off-roading and disturbing wildlife, this will make our local youth and communities active partners in protecting Ladakh's fragile ecosystem, instilling a deep sense of custodianship, while creating sustainable livelihood opportunities. A proud milestone for community-based conservation."

(Photo Source: LG Ladakh's 'X' handle)

item.description:
Secretary, Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, Chanchal Kumar, said that India’s live events sector grew by 44 per cent over the past year, with around 34,000 events held across the country and the sector now supporting more than one crore livelihoods. Addressing the 5th meeting of the Live Events Development Cell (LEDC), he also said that the Government has set an ambitious target of doubling the sector by 2030.

The meeting reviewed the implementation of the Single Window Clearances Portal for the live event industry on the India Cine Hub (ICH) portal. States and UTs were asked to designate Nodal Officers, nominate authorised officers from departments, integrate departmental and local licensing systems with the ICH Portal, route the complete licence lifecycle through the portal, onboard live event venues and notify live event licensing as a time-bound public service.

item.title: 🇧🇩 BANGLADESH: PATHAO ALLEGEDLY HIT WITH 133GB DATA EXTORTION, 19M USER RECORDS CLAIMED A threat actor on an underground forum has posted a publ...
item.description:
🇧🇩 BANGLADESH: PATHAO ALLEGEDLY HIT WITH 133GB DATA EXTORTION, 19M USER RECORDS CLAIMED

A threat actor on an underground forum has posted a public "notice" to Pathao Limited, the Dhaka-based ride-hailing, delivery and fintech super app, claiming to hold its production data and demanding payment.

The listing claims:
* ~250 million rows across 591 tables (133 GB)
* A user master table of 19,063,918 accounts with emails, phone numbers, legal names, password hashes, GPS data and Facebook IDs/access tokens
* 19,059,387 National ID (NID) numbers and 19,046,583 driving licence entries, plus profile photos and 5.7M home addresses
* HR records for 549 employees (NID, salary, religion, emergency contacts), 17,943 merchant bank account/routing records and 845,872 direct-debit records
* A 400,000 USDT ransom demand with a 24-hour deadline, and a threat to keep releasing data

The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
The post lists table names and row counts, but the captured page shows no sample records, so the figures cannot be checked. A Pathao claim from what appears to be the same actor first surfaced a day earlier, and the actor says a local newspaper has already reported a service outage; Pathao has not confirmed either. If genuine, national ID, licence and address data at this scale would create serious identity-fraud and SIM-swap risk in Bangladesh. This is an unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation that Pathao was breached. Users should expect Pathao-themed phishing and account-recovery scams and should change any reused passwords.

#DDW #DarkWeb #Bangladesh #Pathao #DataBreach #Extortion #ThreatIntelligence #CyberSecurity

item.description: President of India (@rashtrapatibhvn) posts, "I extend my warm greetings to Prime Minister Shri @narendramodi Ji on completing 25 years as Head of Government at state and national levels. This momentous milestone reflects a steadfast commitment to the well-being of the people and an enduring resolve to advance the progress of Bharat. The transformation witnessed across our country in recent years is visible in the lives of people. From expanding access to housing, healthcare, financial services, clean energy and basic amenities to strengthening connectivity, digital infrastructure and opportunities, transformative initiatives have touched lives of millions across the length and breadth of Bharat. The remarkable progress in reducing poverty and improving the quality of life of our people reflects the scale and depth of this transformation. Bharat is moving ahead with confidence and renewed aspirations, while the world looks towards India with renewed respect and confidence. May the people of India continue to benefit from your guidance and resolve as the nation advances towards the realisation of the vision of a Viksit Bharat by 2047. I wish you good health, happiness and continued strength in the years ahead, as you remain dedicated to the service of Bharat and its people."

item.title: 🚨 SONICWALL PATCHES CVSS 10.0 UNAUTHENTICATED SSRF IN SMA1000 REMOTE-ACCESS GATEWAYS (CVE-2026-102255) SonicWall released platform hotfixes on Octo...
item.description:
🚨 SONICWALL PATCHES CVSS 10.0 UNAUTHENTICATED SSRF IN SMA1000 REMOTE-ACCESS GATEWAYS (CVE-2026-102255)

SonicWall released platform hotfixes on October 6, 2026 for a maximum-severity server-side request forgery flaw in its SMA1000 secure remote access appliances.

• CVE: CVE-2026-102255 (advisory SNWLID-2026-0017), CVSS 3.0 10.0
• Affected: Appliance WorkPlace interface on SMA1000 6210, 7210 and 8200v running 12.4.3-03526 or 12.5.0-02952 platform-hotfix and older
• Fixed: 12.4.3-03670 and 12.5.0-03082 platform-hotfix or later
• Impact: a remote, unauthenticated attacker could make the appliance send requests on their behalf, reach internal functionality and perform unauthorized operations
• Same advisory: three post-auth flaws (CVE-2026-102256 RCE, CVE-2026-102257 Zip Slip, CVE-2026-102258 stored XSS)
• Not affected: SMA 100 series and SSL-VPN on SonicWall firewalls

⚠️ Analyst Note:
SonicWall says there is no evidence of exploitation in the wild, and the CVE is not in CISA KEV at handoff. SMA1000 appliances have been exploited as zero-days before (CVE-2025-23006 in January 2025), so treat this as a priority patch for any internet-facing appliance.

Official:
https://psirt.global.sonicwall.com/vuln-detail/SNWLID-2026-0017

#DDW #DarkWeb #CyberSecurity #SonicWall #CVE #PatchNow
